environment.notes: Portable audit-only specification; open/not-run is intentional. Actual repair and independent acceptance receipts are separate delivery artifacts.

invariants.text: 租户边界覆盖数据库 RLS、运行时上下文、事件、缓存和外部连接器。
经营事件、审批和关键回执只增不改；纠正通过新事件表达，不静默覆盖证据。
所有外部或变更性动作及其子调用，统一经过权限、PII、围栏和审批链路。
涉钱、敏感数据、群发、公开发布、交易和破坏性变更必须按高风险处理并由人审批。
没有真实回执就不能标记完成；mock、模拟和体验模式在数据结构与界面上都要明确区分。
客户原始经营数据不得上行；蜂群只接受白名单化、最小化、匿名化且可审计的元数据或派生经验。
租户覆盖层只能收紧围栏，不能放宽平台不可变红线。
模型、提示词、技能、bundle、策略和热更新必须先评测再灰度，且始终可回滚。
platform-ops、平台账户运营和平台秘密只属于 Andromeda。
Tiger 在获得单独的合规审查和用户明确授权前，只能模拟或纸面交易。
令牌、密码、API key、私钥、客户凭证和私密客户数据不得进入源码、文档、上下文、提示词、日志或提交。
个性化与行业扩展不得形成公共机制的第二事实源。

cards.title: Persisted task plans are hidden from task details and the experience probe misses asynchronous plan updates

evidence.note: A: Root read all 466 lines. ThreadRow/load/rendering have no persisted plan field or ordered plan list.
C: Root read the full threads.get block; its SELECT omits plan. This does not claim full reading of the large router.
C: Root read the complete EXP05 dispatch flow. It checks only the initial detail/events and omits the actual label field.
B: Independent read-only database observation: T525 completed 2/2 with two persisted labels, without task mutation.

B+C: Actual normal detail navigation, API and visible text. Root and independent actor viewed both screenshots. The diagnostic exit1 belongs to a later EXP03 binding guard; it is not reported as an overall pass.

cards.trigger_path: Normal P1 dispatch queues a task. Scheduler persists and executes QuestStep plans, but threads.get omits plan and P2 displays only generic events. EXP05 ends after the initial query without observing later plans.

assertions.given: Protected threads.get and isolated PostgreSQL with valid/null/empty/malformed plans, cross-workspace and unauthenticated access, and private execution fields.
assertions.expect: Preserve access boundaries, return only stepId/label and truthful plan state, reject malformed plans without inventing success or leaking params, preserve fallback warnings verbatim.

assertions.given: Actual P2 with production styles at desktop/mobile widths, long labels, pending/empty/invalid/offline states, delayed same-task plans, and positive/negative probe evidence.
assertions.expect: Render real ordered plan labels and truthful state. EXP05 requires same-task visible labels within the original dispatchAt deadline; wrong-thread, absent, hidden or late plans cannot pass.

cards.fix_plan: Project persisted plan into a minimal read-only DTO. Render ordered labels and truthful state in P2. Observe same-thread later polling with real labels and the unchanged action/time thresholds.
cards.rollback: Ordinary revert of this card source/tests, exact client repair binding and CI registration. No database migration or historical plan rewrite.
cards.blast_radius: Tiger task detail read display and corresponding experience observation only. No scheduling, planning, tool execution, fences, approvals or trading-strategy changes. New projected fields appear only on the existing protected detail endpoint.
